description: A frontal plane unilateral squat that improves hip adductor flexibility, ankle dorsiflexion, and single-leg quadricep strength.
setup: Take a very wide standing stance (roughly twice shoulder width) with toes angled slightly outward.
steps: Shift your weight over to one side, bending working knee while keeping opposite leg completely straight.
Sink hips deep into the working heel while rotating straight leg's toes up toward ceiling.
Drive through working heel to press back up to tall center standing position.
cues: Keep working heel pinned to the floor
Stay as upright through the torso as mobility allows

mistakes.mistake: Working heel elevating high off the floor
mistakes.fix: Limit squat depth until ankle mobility improves or hold a counterweight/pole for balance

mistakes.mistake: Excessive forward rounding through thoracic and lumbar spine
mistakes.fix: Open chest, extend arms forward, and hinge hips backward rather than slumping

rep_standard: Working hip crease descends below knee with opposite leg fully straight, returning to center lockout
